title: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.
passage_1:
Owen Dalgleish (10:12 A.M.)
Mira, are you nearly finished with the arrangements for our company’s presence at the Northern Hospitality Expo?

Mira Castellanos (10:13 A.M.)
Getting there. But I am worried that the booth we booked is too narrow.

Owen Dalgleish (10:14 A.M.)
Perhaps we should ask for a wider one. Could you ring the exhibition center straight after lunch?

Mira Castellanos (10:16 A.M.)
The marketing team meets at 1:30. We are choosing the models who will appear in the new advertisement for our seasonal blend, which will run in Café Trade Monthly. Ivo Petrenko has taken pictures of several candidates for us to pick from.

Owen Dalgleish (10:17 A.M.)
Understood. I will bring Dario into the chat and see whether he can do it.

Dario Bianchi (10:19 A.M.)
Hello. I can change our booth booking this afternoon. Mira, did you have a specific position in mind?

Mira Castellanos (10:21 A.M.)
There are several wider booths in Hall 2. You can see the ones I’m mentioning on the layout plan posted on the center’s home page.

Dario Bianchi (10:22 A.M.)
I will look at that now and book one when I am back from lunch.
